As you all know, I love maintaining my femininity while still looking put together in uniform, and I love brands that help me do both while also giving me a chance to unwind after hectic days at the office. That’s why I’m so grateful for Dollar Shave Club! Not only do they help me feel confident and polished, but they also turn my evening routine into a little moment of relaxation after long days as a Navy JAG. I also really appreciate their outward support of servicemembers and the military community!
If you’ve been wanting to upgrade your routine, definitely check out both their military collection and women’s line. The products are genuinely so fun and make everyday routines feel a little more personal. 🫶🏽 @dollarshaveclub
